settings.title: Why an HVAC Maintenance Plan Pays for Itself

settings.editor: Catch small issues at a spring or fall visit before they become emergency repairs in July or January.
A tuned system runs more efficiently, which means lower monthly heating and cooling costs.
Consistent maintenance helps your furnace and AC last years longer, delaying a big replacement.
Most manufacturers require documented annual maintenance to keep your equipment warranty valid.

settings.html: Included in every plan

settings.editor: A detailed inspection of every major component each visit, so problems get caught early.
No diagnostic charges, no trip fees, and no overtime, night, or weekend charges — ever.
Seasonal tune-ups timed to prep your system for Iowa summers and winters.
No sticky notes needed. We send automated email and text reminders and call to book your visits each spring and fall.
Guaranteed priority dispatch for no-heat and no-cooling emergencies (response speed varies by plan).
Save on parts all year long (10–20% depending on your plan).

Our plans don't just protect your system — they reward you for staying. Every year you renew, you bank a loyalty bonus: $50 with Red, $100 with White, or $150 with Blue. The longer you stay enrolled, the more you earn.

Even better, your bonus is transferable — if you sell your home and the new owner continues the agreement, the banked reward goes with the house. It's a smart investment in your comfort and your home's resale value.

settings.html: How it works

settings.editor: Enroll online or by phone in a couple of minutes.
We reach out each spring and fall to book your seasonal tune-ups.
Your system stays efficient, your repairs are discounted, and your loyalty bonus grows.

settings.html:
Lenz maintenance plans start at $120/year for the Red plan, with White at $160 and Blue at $220 (plus tax). Each step up adds more visits, faster emergency response, bigger repair discounts, and a larger loyalty bonus.

It's a full check of all major heating and cooling components performed at each maintenance visit to catch wear and small issues before they cause a breakdown. There are no diagnostic or trip fees for plan members.

Between two and four visits per year, depending on your plan — always including a spring air conditioner check and a fall furnace check. We contact you to schedule each one.

Plan members get guaranteed priority emergency service with no overtime, night, or weekend fees. Response time is within 72, 48, or 24 hours depending on your plan.
